==Objectives==
Bring Bixxle's Report to Baron Telraz at the Tel Co. Basecamp in Tel'Abim.
* [[Bixxle's Report]] (provided)

==Description==
Well, here we are, still very much alive and kicking. We did have our fair share of encounters with the local wildlife.

I prepared a report to Baron Telraz, bring it back to Tel Co. Basecamp, it'll let him know we're still kicking up here, whenever he brings in the big guns to clean things up.

==Rewards==
* 1400 experience

==Progress==
So, have you heard news from Bixxle's Storehouse?

==Completion==
A report from Bixxle himself? Give me that!

<Baron Telraz frantically reads the letter with utmost curiosity, letting out a sigh of relief.>

My, that certainly is a relief! Without Bixxle, I would have no idea how to manage things up there. Thanks for the work kid. Here, take some coins for the hassle of running around.
